description: This file implements a command-line utility called 'usleep' that pauses execution for a specified number of microseconds, with command-line options for displaying version information and a custom message. It includes command-line argument parsing, usage of the 'popt' library, and calls the 'usleep' system function.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Entry point of the program that processes command-line arguments, displays information or errors, and calls 'usleep' with the specified microsecond delay.
